[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 2: Game Server Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.1[/color] If you are banned from a role, you may not play that role. This includes seeking or accepting promotions into restricted roles, as well as taking ghost roles that occupy those positions. ★★
[color=#a4885c]2.2[/color] Do not intentionally become a major problem, nuisance, or disruption to civilians while not being an antagonist (i.e. self-antagging). ★★
[color=#a4885c]2.3[/color] Livestreaming rounds to others or sharing recorded gameplay outside of the Triad Sector without the consent of all parties involved is strictly prohibited. ★★
[color=#a4885c]2.4[/color] Ghosting with the sole purpose of spying on the private activities of others is not permitted. ★★
